name: ilovemusic-desktop
description: ILoveMusic - SoundCloud & Spotify Music Downloader and Player with BPM Detection (Premium Quality - 320kbps)
author: CactusDomain

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix renderer" "electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && node scripts/build-desktop.js
scripts.build:mac: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && node scripts/build-desktop.js --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && node scripts/build-desktop.js --win
scripts.build:linux: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && node scripts/build-desktop.js --linux
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run test --workspace @ilovemusic/api && npm run test --workspace @ilovemusic/cli
